Description
Card
a record class that represents one card with rank and suit it implements an interface Comparable and because of that we cn compare cards based on their value
ClientState
A clas that stores the network connection state with a client.
CommandParser
A class responsible for parsing raw text messages (String) received by the server and converting them into a {GameCommand object.
CommandType
A class that contains every possible command that can be sent from client to the server or from server to the client
Deck
A class that represents a whole deck of cards, it contains a total of 52 cards, 4 suits and 13 ranks
GameClient
A class that represents the network client for the Poker Game, utilizing blocking I/O (sockets and streams) to communicate with the non-blocking NioPokerServer This class operates using a two-thread model: the main thread handles user input and sending commands and a separate worker thread listens for incoming messages from the server.
GameCommand
A class that represents a single command or game event, parsed from a text message.
GameEngine
A class that is responsible for the correct round course and correct state change
GameServiceHandler
A class of server logic module it manages GameEngine instances.
GameServiceHandler.ServiceResult
A record used to package and return the necessary information to the network (NioPokerServer) after processing a command.
GameState
An enum class that defines all the possible states in the round of poker
Hand
A class Hand that represents a player's hand that contains five cards
HandChecker
A class that checks if hand of five cards has any possible layouts checking by the highest to the lowest
HandRanking
An enum class that contains of all the possible string layouts of player's hand and a power of them
HandValue
A class that represents the final strength and value of a 5 card poker hand.
IllegalDrawException
Exception thrown when a player attempts to exchange cards that does not match the five cards poker rules.
InvalidMoveException
Exception thrown when a player tries to make na illegal move
NioPokerServer
A class that represents the core server implementation using Java NIO.
NotEnoughChipsException
Exception thrown when a player tries to give more chips then he has on his hand
OutOfTurnException
Exception thrown when a player tries to make an action (BET, FOLD, CHECK) when it is not his / her turn
Player
A class that represents a single player in the poker table
PokerClientAppMain
The main application class and entry point for the Poker Game Client.
PokerServerAppMain
A main application class and entry point for the Poker Game Server.
ProtocolException
Exception thrown when the server receives a network message that is incorrect or incomplete
Rank
An enum class that collects all the possible ranks of cards and assign to them a value that allows the cards to be comparable with o
RankComparator
A class of comparator used to sort the cards layouts to reveal who has the highest ranking It is very crucial in the ties when two players have 'FULL_HOUSE' and then three the same cards are more important than two cards (for example THREE KINGS AND TWO TENS > THREE QUEENS AND TWO ACES)
SecurityException
Exception thrown when the server detects an action that violates the security of the game state, for example cheating or abuse
StateMismatchException
Exception thrown when the state of round (BET1, DRAW, BET2, ...) is not correct according to the rules of the game
Suit
An enum class Suit that collects of the possible colors of card (SPADES, CLUBS, HEARTS, DIAMONDS) and assign to them their string name
